# Feature `image:perf`

Image feature `perf`:

Installs profiling tools such as `perf`, `systemtap`, and `LTTng`. For general information on user-space tools, see the Yocto Project Application Development and the Extensible Software Development Kit (eSDK) manual.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/features.html#image-features
